rows.title: Effects of acute caffeine supplementation on physical, physiological, and sport-specific performance in female volleyball players: a systematic review and three-level meta-analysis.
rows.focus: Systematic review and three-level meta-analysis of five randomized controlled trials in 66 female volleyball athletes. Evidence certainty was very low; no clear consistent ergogenic effect was demonstrated, and potential adverse effects included tremor, anxiety, and excessive stimulation.

rows.title: Assessment of Liver and Kidney Safety of Silver Fir (Abies alba) Branch Extract: An Open-Label Human Study of a Dietary Supplement.
rows.focus: Open-label single-arm study in 15 healthy adults consuming standardized silver fir branch extract for 14 days. Liver and kidney biochemical markers remained within reference ranges and no adverse events were reported; evidence is short-term and uncontrolled.
